Title: TOM: Q: Deflecting a Minor Boonee

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Vampire V1 goes to Torpor.
Methuselah M2 plays Minor Boon to save V1.
later...
V1 bleed M3.
M3 plays deflection - naming M2 as the target of the bleed.

What happens?

a) Deflection cannot name M2 since M2 isn't a valid target for V1.
b) V1's bleed is automatically unsuccessful (fizzles).
c) ???
--
